usage: POST any element of packs to /api/bundles/from-workflow, or run tools/model_packs.py install <id>.

packs.name: Qwen-Image 2.1 (T2I + edit)
packs.description: Alibaba's newest open image model (7B, Sep 2026): text-to-image, editing and background removal (RGBA) from one checkpoint, native 2K.
packs.settings: 25 steps, CFG 1 (CFG 5 degrades badly), euler / simple, 1024² and up.
packs.vram: 16 GB+ (int8 model 7.3 GB + int8 encoder 9.4 GB, offloaded between stages).

packs.name: Qwen-Image 2.1 Turbo (8-step)
packs.description: Distilled Qwen-Image 2.1 (Oct 2026): 8 steps for text-to-image and edits.
packs.settings: 8 steps, CFG 1, euler, with the template's fixed ManualSigmas (keep the schedule if you change steps).

packs.name: Qwen-Image 2512 (20B, Lightning)
packs.description: The 20B Apache-2.0 Qwen-Image (Dec 2025 refresh): best open text rendering with a commercial-friendly licence. Includes the 4-step Lightning LoRA and the 2512 Fun ControlNet Union.
packs.settings: Standard: 50 steps, CFG 4, euler / simple, AuraFlow shift 3.1, 1328². Lightning: 4 steps, CFG 1.
packs.vram: 24 GB+ (20.4 GB fp8 model; text encoder offloads).

packs.name: Qwen-Image-Edit 2511 (Lightning)
packs.description: The 20B Apache-2.0 instruction editor (multi-image input, consistent identity). Includes the 4-step Lightning LoRA and the most-used camera-angle LoRA.
packs.settings: Standard: 40 steps, CFG 3, euler / simple, shift 3.1. Lightning: 4 steps, CFG 1. Multiple-angles LoRA at 0.8-1.0.

packs.name: Qwen-Image Layered (RGBA layers)
packs.description: Splits an image into editable RGBA layers.
packs.template: image_qwen_image_layered (switch its loader to the fp8mixed file)
packs.settings: 20 steps, CFG 2.5, euler / simple, AuraFlow shift 1; 640 px input (1024 px for high-res).
packs.vram: 24 GB+ with fp8 (the template's bf16 file is 40.9 GB).

packs.name: Qwen-Image 2512 + Edit 2511 GGUF (low VRAM)
packs.description: Q4_K_M quantisations of Qwen-Image 2512 and Edit 2511 for 12-16 GB cards. Needs the ComfyUI-GGUF node pack (Unet Loader GGUF).
packs.settings: As the fp8 packs; pair with the Lightning LoRAs for 4 steps.

packs.name: Qwen community LoRAs (realism + edit)
packs.description: Most-downloaded SFW Qwen LoRAs on Civitai: Danrisi's UltraReal series for Qwen-Image 2.1, the Real Life and iPhone realism LoRAs for the 20B model, and the Next Scene and Comfy-Org edit LoRAs.
packs.settings: Realism LoRAs 0.6-1.0 (Lenovo UltraReal trigger: l3n0v0). Next Scene: start the prompt with 'Next Scene:', 0.7-0.8.

packs.name: Krea 2 Turbo
packs.description: Krea's own 12.9B model (open weights Jun 2026, not FLUX-based). The most active base on Civitai in late 2026. Includes the official style-reference LoRA.
packs.settings: 8 steps, CFG 1, euler / simple, 1024². Load the text encoder with CLIPLoader type 'krea2'. Style LoRAs at 0.8.
packs.license: Krea 2 Community Licence (custom; commercial use has conditions, read krea.ai/krea-2-licensing).

packs.name: FLUX.1 Krea [dev]
packs.description: The 2025 Krea x BFL photoreal FLUX.1 model. Superseded by Krea 2 but still compatible with the huge FLUX.1-dev LoRA ecosystem.
packs.settings: 20-28 steps, CFG 1, FluxGuidance 4.5, euler / simple, 1024-1280 px.
packs.vram: 16 GB+ on fp8 (24 GB with the fp16 T5).
packs.license: FLUX.1 [dev] Non-Commercial (generated images are usable commercially).

packs.name: FLUX.1 Kontext [dev] (edit)
packs.description: FLUX.1 instruction editing. Largely replaced by Qwen-Image-Edit, FLUX.2/3 Klein and MOSS edit, but many workflows still use it.
packs.settings: 20 steps, CFG 1, FluxGuidance 2.5, euler / simple.

packs.name: FLUX.2 [dev] (+ Turbo LoRA)
packs.description: BFL's 32B FLUX.2 [dev] (Nov 2025) with multi-reference editing; the Turbo LoRA brings it to 8 steps.
packs.template: image_flux2 (switch the text encoder to the fp8 file)
packs.settings: 20 steps, FluxGuidance 4, euler, Flux2Scheduler; Turbo LoRA: 8 steps.
packs.vram: 48 GB class (35.5 GB model + 18 GB fp8 encoder; 24 GB works with heavy offloading).

packs.name: FLUX.2 [klein] 4B
packs.description: Small, fast FLUX.2 (Jan 2026) for text-to-image and editing; the only Apache-licensed FLUX.2. Distilled (4 steps) and base models.
packs.settings: Distilled: 4 steps, CFG 1, euler. Base: 20-50 steps, CFG 5.

packs.name: FLUX 3 [klein] (image)
packs.description: BFL's open FLUX 3 Image Klein (Oct 2026): text-to-image and editing, distilled and base, with a Qwen3.5 prompt upsampler. Gated: accept the licence on Hugging Face and add an HF token.
packs.settings: Distilled: 15 steps, CFG 1, er_sde / simple. Base: 15-50 steps (edit template 50, euler).
packs.vram: 16 GB+ (5.8 GB model, 4.9 GB encoder, 6.7 GB upsampler).
packs.license: FLUX Kommunity Licence (gated; read the terms before commercial use).

packs.name: Chroma1-HD
packs.description: Apache-2.0, uncensored 8.9B model derived from FLUX.1 [schnell]; uses real CFG and negative prompts.
packs.settings: 26 steps, CFG 3.5, euler / beta, AuraFlow shift 1. Needs a negative prompt.

packs.name: MOSS-Image (T2I + edit + control)
packs.description: OpenMOSS's Apache-2.0 model (Oct 2026), adopted by Civitai within days. SFT model, the official edit LoRA, the colour/depth control LoRA with its MoGe depth estimator, and the most-downloaded 4-step turbo LoRA.
packs.settings: T2I: 25 steps, CFG 2.5, er_sde / simple. Edit LoRA: 30 steps, CFG 4, euler / normal. Turbo LoRA: 4 steps, CFG 1.
packs.vram: 12 GB+ (5.4 GB int8 model, 7.3 GB w4a8 encoder).

packs.name: MOSS-Image community realism
packs.description: Top SFW MOSS LoRAs from its first weeks on Civitai: Lenovo UltraReal, UltraReal v2, GrainScape, Realistic Snapshot, Phone Photography 2025, Realism Enhancer, 2000s Analog Core.
packs.settings: 0.6-1.0 on MOSS SFT (Lenovo trigger: l3n0v0).

packs.name: Z-Image Turbo (+ ControlNet)
packs.description: Tongyi's 6B 8-step model (Apache-2.0): fast photoreal, the 2026 community workhorse. Includes the Fun ControlNet Union 2.1.
packs.settings: 8 steps, CFG 1, res_multistep / simple, AuraFlow shift 3, no negative prompt. Text encoder: CLIPLoader type lumina2.
packs.vram: 12-16 GB (bf16 model 12.3 GB; an int8 file is in the same repo).

packs.name: Z-Image Base
packs.description: The non-distilled Z-Image (Jan 2026): full CFG and negative prompts, the base most Z-Image LoRAs are trained on.
packs.settings: 25 steps, CFG 4, res_multistep / simple, shift 3.

packs.name: Z-Image Turbo community
packs.description: CyberRealistic ZIT v10 (the most-downloaded SFW Z-Image finetune) and the top SFW Z-Image Turbo LoRAs: Realistic Snapshot v5, Lenovo UltraReal, GrainScape, 2000s Analog Core, Aesthetic, Flow-DPO and Pixel Art.
packs.settings: Same as Z-Image Turbo. LoRAs 0.6-1.0 (Pixel Art trigger: 'Pixel Art style.').
packs.license: Apache-2.0 base + each model's Civitai terms.

packs.name: ERNIE-Image Turbo
packs.description: Baidu's 8B Apache-2.0 model with a prompt enhancer; strong on Chinese and English text.
packs.settings: 8 steps, CFG 1, euler / simple. Base model: ~50 steps, CFG 4-5.

packs.name: SDXL photoreal + essentials
packs.description: The two most-used SDXL photo checkpoints (Juggernaut XL Ragnarok, 528k downloads; RealVisXL V5) with the DMD2 4-step LoRA, Xinsir ControlNet Union ProMax and the SDXL VAE. Runs on 8 GB.
packs.settings: Juggernaut: 30-40 steps, CFG 3-6, DPM++ 2M SDE, 832x1216. DMD2: 4-8 steps, CFG 1, lcm / sgm_uniform.
packs.license: RealVisXL: OpenRAIL++. Juggernaut: RunDiffusion licence (read before commercial/API use). DMD2: CC BY-NC 4.0.

packs.name: Illustrious anime (WAI v17)
packs.description: WAI-illustrious-SDXL, the most-downloaded anime checkpoint on Civitai (1.58M). Mature-capable; the file is named WAI-Nsfw-Illustrious-17.
packs.settings: Euler a, 25-30 steps, CFG 5-7, 832x1216, Danbooru-style tags.

packs.name: Upscale, restore & interpolate
packs.description: SeedVR2 3B int8 (native ComfyUI image/video upscaler), 4x-UltraSharp and Real-ESRGAN x4+, RIFE 4.26 and FILM frame interpolation, face/hand YOLO detectors for detailers, BiRefNet background removal.
packs.settings: SeedVR2: 1 step, CFG 1. RIFE 4.26 is the fast default, FILM the quality option.
packs.vram: SeedVR2 3B int8: 12 GB+. Everything else: any GPU.
packs.license: Apache-2.0 / BSD / MIT; 4x-UltraSharp is CC BY-NC-SA.

packs.name: Wan 2.2 I2V 14B (+ first/last frame)
packs.description: Official Wan 2.2 image-to-video (MoE high/low-noise pair) with the template's 4-step lightx2v LoRAs. Also drives first-last-frame (FLF2V). The base every Civitai Wan merge builds on.
packs.settings: 4-step: CFG 1, euler / simple, shift 5, steps 0-2 high then 2-4 low. Without LoRAs: 20 steps, CFG 3.5, split 10/10, shift 8. 640-720p, 81 frames, 16 fps.
packs.vram: 24 GB recommended (two 14.3 GB experts load one at a time); 16 GB with offloading.

packs.name: Wan 2.2 T2V 14B
packs.description: Official Wan 2.2 text-to-video with the template's 4-step lightx2v LoRAs (v1.1).
packs.settings: 4-step: CFG 1, euler / simple, shift 5, split 2/2. Without LoRAs: 20 steps, CFG 3.5, split 10/10, shift 8. 640-720p, 81 frames, 16 fps.

packs.name: Wan 2.2 TI2V 5B (8 GB)
packs.description: The small Wan 2.2: text- or image-to-video at 720p/24 fps on 8 GB cards. Uses the Wan 2.2 VAE (not 2.1).
packs.settings: 20 steps, CFG 5, uni_pc / simple, shift 8, 1280x704, 121 frames, 24 fps.

packs.name: Wan 2.2 I2V GGUF Q4 (12-16 GB)
packs.description: QuantStack Q4_K_M Wan 2.2 I2V pair for 12-16 GB cards, with the 4-step LoRAs. Needs ComfyUI-GGUF.
packs.settings: As Wan 2.2 I2V (4 steps, CFG 1, split 2/2).

packs.name: Wan 2.2 Fun Control (pose/depth/canny)
packs.description: Wan 2.2 Fun Control 14B: drive video with pose, depth, canny, MLSD or trajectories. Uses the I2V 4-step LoRAs.
packs.settings: 20 steps, CFG 3.5, split 10/10, shift 8; or 4 steps CFG 1 with the LoRAs.

packs.name: Wan 2.2 Fun VACE (all-in-one editing)
packs.description: Wan 2.2 Fun VACE 14B: reference-to-video, video inpainting/outpainting and control in one model.
packs.template: video_wan_vace_14B_ref2v, video_wan_vace_inpainting, video_wan_vace_outpainting (2.1 templates; swap in these models)
packs.settings: 20 steps, CFG 3.5, split 10/10; or 4 steps CFG 1 with the T2V LoRAs.

packs.name: Wan 2.2 S2V (talking video)
packs.description: Wan 2.2 speech-to-video: image + audio to a talking/singing video.
packs.settings: 10 steps per chunk, CFG 6, uni_pc / simple, shift 8, 77-frame chunks, 16 fps. The 4-step LoRA path loses motion quality.

packs.name: Wan Animate 2 (character animation)
packs.description: Wan-AI's Animate 2 (Aug 2026): animate a character image from a driving video, or replace a character in a video. Distilled model, no speed LoRA needed.
packs.settings: 10 steps, lcm / simple, shift 5, 30 fps output.

packs.name: Wan 2.2 add-ons (newer speed LoRAs, long video, camera)
packs.description: lightx2v's newer distill LoRAs (I2V 1022, T2V 1217), SVI 2.0 Pro for long continuous videos, and the most-downloaded SFW motion/style LoRAs: CameraRotation, Face-to-Feet camera, Anime Style v2.
packs.settings: Speed LoRAs replace the Comfy v1/v1.1 ones (1.0 each, 4 steps). SVI Pro needs its workflow (e.g. DaSiWa C-SVI). Camera LoRAs 0.8-1.0 on the expert they were trained for.
packs.license: Apache-2.0 (lightx2v, SVI) + each LoRA's Civitai terms.

packs.name: DaSiWa Wan 2.2 I2V Lightspeed v11
packs.description: Darksidewalker's DaSiWa, the most popular Wan 2.2 I2V merge on Civitai (184k downloads, 11 releases). v11 'SnatchKiss' (May 2026), lightning distillation baked in. Mature-oriented (SFW and NSFW).
packs.template: Creator's FastFidelity C-AiO workflow: civitai.com/models/1823089 (needs VideoHelperSuite, KJNodes, ComfyUI-GGUF, ComfyUI-DaSiWa-Nodes)
packs.settings: 4 steps, CFG 1, euler / simple (or uni_pc_bh2), shift 5, up to 720p, 81-97 frames at 16-24 fps. Don't add Lightning LoRAs; other LoRAs at 0.3-0.6. Negative prompts do nothing at CFG 1.
packs.vram: 16 GB+ (14.2 GB per expert). The fp8_mixed files in the same versions (18.8 GB) are higher fidelity for 32 GB+ cards.
packs.license: Apache-2.0 tag, but the creator forbids re-hosting: download from Civitai or the official HF repo only.

packs.settings: Distilled two-stage: euler_ancestral, CFG 1, the template's ManualSigmas (8 + 3 steps), 768x512, 97 frames, 24 fps; the spatial upscaler doubles resolution.
packs.vram: 24 GB+ (21.5 GB int8 transformer + 15.4 GB encoder, offloaded).
packs.license: LTX-2.x Community Licence (gated; read before commercial use).
